items.title: Archie Martin Interview, 1960-09-03
items.q: Buddy Blissett, he was, he was the president of that at that time.

ctx.x: Now, the Eclipse, did that have anything to do with Eclipse Alley?

No. No, that was Eclipse Social Aid and Pleasure Club. That was, that was at, uh, Fultz and Ferret. Uh, Buddy Blissett, he was, he was the president of that at that time. At that time we used horses in carriages when they would parade. See, we didn't have no automobiles, they'd use carriages. So, that was back in, oh, way back in 1950s, 60s.
What about people back in those times? Did they bury with a band of music then?
